sections.head: 他们不缺判断力,缺的是一张入场券。
sections.text: Maria · 马尼拉外卖骑手 月入 $270。想入股隔壁奶茶店,对方说: 最低 $25,000。 Kwame · 拉各斯网约车司机 看好 AI 赛道。机构说: 最低 $100,000,锁 5 年。 Elena · 圣保罗退休教师 月养老金 $550。 看不懂白皮书,也买不起矿机。 全球后 50% 人口(约 40 亿人)仅拥有约 2% 的总财富;优质资产被合格投资者门槛挡在门外。LightDAO 就是为这三个人设计的。 CONTRAST · 对比冲击

sections.head: 不承诺,只展示已验证的。
sections.text: 链 :lightdao-mainnet-1,7 验证者(JP/KR/SG/US/HK/FR/UK)全部 BONDED。 Gas 经济 :USD 锚定 min-gas(动态价 2026-10-01 提案生效后启用);50/30/20 已实测精确分配。 Passkey 钱包 :WebAuthn 无种子登录 + Shamir 3-of-5 社交恢复;解锁密码/生物识别二次验证。 WebRTC 中继 :8 节点 coturn + WSS 信令,端到端实测通过。 挖矿闭环 :浏览器贡献 → 网关定稿 → Merkle 根 5/7 多签上链 → 凭 proof 领取。 价格预言机 :外部中位数喂价现役;7 验证者轮值 + TWAP 主源切换排期中;当前参考价 $0.05。 合约 :开源、可自验;持续自审 + 每日独立对账;第三方审计排期中。 TOKEN · 关键数字

sections.head: 25 亿硬顶,永不增发。
sections.text: 指标 数值 LIGHT 总量 25 亿枚,永不增发 挖矿产出 10 亿枚,每 2 年减半 投资金库 8.5 亿枚(基准可部署 ≈ $1 亿) 首纪元日释放 ≈ 68.49 万枚 通缩底线 流通 ≤ 10 亿枚时停止销毁(白皮书条款,合约开关排期中) 提案门槛 链上现行质押 1,000 LIGHT;白皮书资格线 5,000 LIGHT + 连续质押 30 天 委员会门槛 ≥ 50,000 LIGHT(竞选质押) RISK · 透明才可信 链上投资仍有归零风险,参与需谨慎。 投票权按份额计算,非一人一票。 智能合约开源并持续自审,但非绝对安全。 退出流动性取决于市场,不保证随时成交。 LIGHT 不是证券,不具内在价值,价格可能归零。

sections.head: Blog
sections.text: Shipped, weekly. Engineering notes from lightdao-mainnet-1. 2026-06-18

sections.head: Mainnet fee-burn is live: 50% of every gas fee, gone forever
sections.text: With the v2-lightfee coordinated upgrade, every transaction on lightdao-mainnet-1 now splits its fee 50% burn / 30% validators / 20% treasury, enforced at the chain layer (x/lightfee), not by convention. Gas is USD-anchored so a reference transfer costs ~$0.001 regardless of LIGHT price. Burn is verifiable: watch the burn address balance only ever rise. Try it in the app → · RSS 2026-04-02

sections.head: We deleted the seed phrase (and the #1 way users lose funds)
sections.text: LightDAO wallets log in with Passkey/WebAuthn biometrics; the mnemonic is encrypted device-side and never shown by default, with Shamir 3-of-5 social recovery as backup. Mnemonic remains only as an optional fallback. Result: onboarding in seconds and no 12 words to lose. Try it in the app → · RSS 2026-02-11

sections.head: Your browser is now infrastructure: device-direct WebRTC relay
sections.text: Light nodes form a P2P mesh over WebRTC with an 8-region TURN/TURNS fleet for symmetric NAT. Relayed bytes are metered on-device and score 40% of mining reward, verified by validator challenges + peer attestation + per-block Merkle root. Try it in the app → · RSS 2025-12-05

sections.head: Gas that doesn't move with the token: USD-anchored pricing
sections.text: min-gas-price is derived from an on-chain TWAP oracle so fees stay stable in USD terms even before a LIGHT/USDC pool exists. When liquidity arrives, the oracle switches to real market median automatically via governance parameter. Try it in the app → · RSS <div style="text-align:center;padding:14px

sections.head: Privacy Policy 隐私政策
sections.text: LightDAO is a self-custodial, browser-native protocol. We minimize data by design.

sections.head: What we do NOT collect
sections.text: No accounts, no emails required to mine (newsletter is opt-in). No private keys, seeds, or Passkey credentials ever leave your device. No third-party ad trackers or analytics beacons on the client.

sections.head: What the network necessarily sees
sections.text: Your wallet address and on-chain transactions (public by nature of a blockchain). Mining contribution metrics you broadcast (bandwidth/uptime/verification/stability) and an anti-sybil device fingerprint hash + IP, used only to score contribution and prevent fraud. Standard server access logs (IP, UA) for security and rate-limiting.

sections.head: Your controls
sections.text: Stop mining any time; contribution broadcasting stops. Clear browser storage to remove local wallet session & referral data. Request log deletion: privacy@lightdao.net.

sections.head: Cookies / local storage
sections.text: We use localStorage/sessionStorage for wallet session, language, and referral attribution only. No cross-site cookies. Effective 2026-09-26 · privacy@lightdao.net Telegram @lightdao_news · Dis

sections.text: LIGHT and sub-tokens are ecosystem contribution credits and SPV profit-distribution claim credentials. Nothing here is a security offering, a wealth-management product, a guarantee of return, or investment advice. Consult legal/tax/financial professionals.

sections.head: Testnet-value phase
sections.text: The network is live but pre-liquidity; tokens currently carry no market price. Do not commit real assets you cannot afford to lose.

sections.head: Acceptable use

sections.head: 节点与验证者 Nodes & Validators
sections.text: LightDAO 有三类节点, 准入方式完全不同 ——依据白皮书 §4.6 / §4.7。 类型 作用 准入 收益 浏览器轻节点 贡献带宽(WebRTC 中继)/区块头验证/在线时长 免申请 · permissionless 打开网页即可 挖矿奖励池 95%(每日) 全节点 同步全链、提供 RPC/中继、增强去中心化 免许可 自行同步即可,见仓库文档 无直接奖励(公益/基础设施) 验证者 BFT 共识出块、承载 WebSocket 网关(≤50k 连接/验证者)、提交心跳 Merkle 根 质押保证金 + 治理选举 非免申请 手续费 30% + 区块奖励 5%

sections.head: 验证者:如何申请 / 竞选
sections.text: 验证者 不是注册制,而是选举制 (白皮书 §4.6 渐进去中心化): 运行一个同步良好的 全节点 (硬件与带宽自足,7×24 在线)。 准备 质押保证金 (LIGHT,权益绑定;作恶或长期离线将被 slashing 罚没)。 在开放席位时提交 候选治理提案 ,由现有治理选举通过(初始 21 席/最低 10/上限 100;社区选举自第 7 个月起逐步开放)。 当选后绑定质押、发布公钥、进入活跃集;维持出勤率,否则被罚没/剔除。 硬性底线: 验证者 < 7 时 TGE 不得执行 (f≤1 单点故障即全链停摆)。当前 7/7 BONDED。 提交候选提案 → 白皮书 §4.6 → 运行文档 →
